Times of trouble are at hand:
Happy they, who love his name!
They shall always find him near;
Though the earth were wrapped in flame,
They have no just cause for fear.
Newton printed the hymn under Isaiah 26:20. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourselves a little while until the wrath has passed. ISAIAH 26:20 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ ISAIAH 26

Hark! his voice in accents mild, (O, how comforting and sweet!) Speaks to every humble child, Pointing out a sure retreat! Come, and in my chambers hide, To my saints of old well known; There you safely may abide, Till the storm be overblown. STANZA II
